name: DocuMind
tagline: AI-native document studio: executive briefs, risk audits, data extraction, multi-doc comparison, and grounded Q&A backed by verified citations.
description: DocuMind is an AI-native document intelligence studio built for Anna OS. Beyond simple chat, it provides five specialized analytical workflows: automated executive briefings, contractual & operational risk auditing, quantitative data & entity extraction, cross-document delta comparison, and interactive retention quizzes—all backed by strict chunk-level citations and grounded confidence scores.
